response.overview: This collection of short films, Strafkolonie, and Ein Baum Für Die Englemänner, are the first rolls James Otis ever exposed. As an impoverished young man studying in Germany, he was befriended by the benevolent artist Gerhard Englemann and his wife. They loaned him their camera, and the rest, as they say, is HIStory. This collection consists of: Dandy Lion König, Tabletop, House Holes, Objects, and Chomsky. Otis bestowed this title on this grouping of early films at Mark Toscano's suggestion in 2021.
response.title: Short Films Für Die Englemänner
